title: Maintained-Set Discount on Workmanship Shares — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Maintained-set discount — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty workmanship shares.** The set's Crestline rotation records earn a discount taken off the prorated share of a workmanship share. The count is every Crestline rotation record on the set; the miles run are the odometer of the inspection entry that records the defect less the install odometer.

- At least one rotation, and at least as many rotations as the miles run divided by 5000, rounded down — **10% of the prorated share off**.
- At least one rotation, fewer than that, but at least as many as the miles run divided by the line's largest rotation gap (6,000 miles on the Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty line, 7,500 on the others), rounded down — **5% of the prorated share off**.
- Any other set — nothing off.

Every part taken off the prorated share is a percentage of the prorated share worked out on its own; together they never take the workmanship share percentage below 0.

**Cases (hypothetical 7,500-mile line, 24,000 miles run):** 4 rotations — 10% off; 3 rotations — 5% off; no rotation — nothing off.
